text_en: I ask, then, has God rejected his people? By no means! I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.
text_cn: 我再问：莫非天主摈弃了自己的人民吗？断然不是！我自己就是个以色列人，出于亚巴郎的后裔，本雅明支派。

text_en: God has not rejected his people whom he foreknew. Do you not know what the scripture says of Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel?
text_cn: 天主并没有摈弃他所预选的人民。难道你们不知道圣经在《厄里亚篇》上说了什么，他怎样向天主抱怨以色列？

text_en: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have demolished your altars; I alone am left, and they are seeking my life. ”
text_cn: “上主呀！他们杀了你的先知，毁坏了你的祭坛，只剩下了我一个，他们还在谋害我的性命。”

text_en: But what is the divine reply to him? “I have kept for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal. ”
text_cn: 然而神谕告诉了他什么？“我为我自己留下了七千人，他们没有向巴耳屈过膝。”

text_en: So too at the present time there is a remnant, chosen by grace.
text_cn: 同样，现在也留下了一些残余，即天主以恩宠所选拔的人。

text_en: But if it is by grace, it is no longer on the basis of works, otherwise grace would no longer be grace.
text_cn: 既然是出于恩宠，就不是出于作为，不然，恩宠就不算为恩宠了。

text_en: What then? Israel failed to obtain what it was seeking. The elect obtained it, but the rest were hardened,
text_cn: 那么还说什么呢？以色列全体所寻求的，没有得到，只有那些蒙选的人得到了；其余的都顽梗不化了。

text_en: as it is written, “God gave them a sluggish spirit, eyes that would not see and ears that would not hear, down to this very day. ”
text_cn: 正如所记载的：“天主赋与了他们沉睡的神，有眼看不见，有耳听不见，直到今日，仍是如此。”

text_en: And David says, “Let their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them;
text_cn: 达味也说过：“愿他们的筵席成为他们的陷阱、罗网、绊脚石和应得的报应。

text_en: let their eyes be darkened so that they cannot see, and keep their backs forever bent. ”
text_cn: 愿他们的眼睛昏迷，不得看见。愿你使他们的脊背常常弯曲。”

text_en: So I ask, have they stumbled so as to fall? By no means! But through their stumbling salvation has come to the Gentiles, so as to make Israel jealous.
text_cn: 那么我再问：他们失足，是要他们永久跌倒吗？绝对不是！而是藉着他们的过犯，使救恩临到外邦人，为刺激他们发愤。

text_en: Now if their stumbling means riches for the world, and if their defeat means riches for Gentiles, how much more will their full inclusion mean!
text_cn: 如果因他们的过犯，世界得以致富，因他们的堕落，外邦人得以致富；他们全体归正，更将怎样呢？

text_en: Now I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch then as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I glorify my ministry
text_cn: 我对你们外邦人说：我既然是外邦人的宗徒，我必要光荣我的职务；

text_en: in order to make my own people jealous, and thus save some of them.
text_cn: 这样，或许可激动我的同胞发愤，因而能拯救他们几个人。

text_en: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead!
text_cn: 如果因他们被遗弃，世界与天主和好了；那么，他们如果蒙收纳，岂不是死而复生吗？

text_en: If the part of the dough offered as first fruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; and if the root is holy, then the branches also are holy.
text_cn: 如果所献的初熟的麦面是圣的，全面团也成为圣的；如果树根是圣的，树枝也是圣的。

text_en: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, were grafted in their place to share the rich root of the olive tree,
text_cn: 假如有几条橄榄树枝被折下来，而你这枝野橄榄树枝被接上去，同沾橄榄树根的肥脂，

text_en: do not boast over the branches. If you do boast, remember that it is not you that support the root, but the root that supports you.
text_cn: 就不可向旧树枝自夸。如果你想自夸，就该想不是你托着树根，而是树根托着你。

text_en: You will say, “Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in. ”
text_cn: 或者你要说：树枝被折下来，正是为叫我接上去。

text_en: That is true. They were broken off because of their unbelief, but you stand only through faith. So do not become proud, but stand in awe.
text_cn: 不错，他们因了不信而被折下来，你要因着信，才站得住。你决不可心高气傲，反应恐惧，

text_en: For if God did not spare the natural branches, perhaps he will not spare you.
text_cn: 因为天主既然没有怜惜了那些原有的树枝，将来也许不怜惜你。

text_en: Note then the kindness and the severity of God: severity toward those who have fallen, but God’s kindness toward you, provided you continue in his kindness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
text_cn: 可见天主又慈善又严厉：天主对于跌倒了的人是严厉的，对于你却是慈善的，只要你存留在他的慈善上；不然你也必要被砍去。

text_en: And even those of Israel, if they do not persist in unbelief, will be grafted in, for God has the power to graft them in again.
text_cn: 至于他们，如果他们不固执于无信之中，必会再被接上去，因为天主有能力重新把他们接上去。

text_en: For if you have been cut from what is by nature a wild olive tree and grafted, contrary to nature, into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these natural branches be grafted back into their own olive tree.
text_cn: 其实，如果你这由本生的野橄榄树上被砍下来的，逆着性被接在好橄榄树上，何况他们那些原生的树枝，岂不更容易接在自己原来的橄榄树上么？

text_en: So that you may not claim to be wiser than you are, brothers and sisters, I want you to understand this mystery: a hardening has come upon part of Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
text_cn: 弟兄们！免得你们自作聪明，我不愿意你们不知道这项奥秘的事，就是只有一部分是执迷不悟的，直到外邦人全数进入天国为止：

text_en: And so all Israel will be saved; as it is written, “Out of Zion will come the Deliverer; he will banish ungodliness from Jacob. ”
text_cn: 那时，全以色列也必获救，正如经上所载：“拯救者必要来自熙雍，从雅各伯中消除不敬之罪；

text_en: “And this is my covenant with them, when I take away their sins. ”
text_cn: 这是我与他们所定立的盟约：那时我要赦免他们的罪恶。”

text_en: As regards the gospel they are enemies of God for your sake; but as regards election they are beloved, for the sake of their ancestors;
text_cn: 照福音来说，他们由于你们的缘故，成了天主的仇人；但照召选来说，由于他们祖先的缘故，他们仍是可爱的，

text_en: for the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
text_cn: 因为天主的恩赐和召选是决不会撤回的。

text_en: Just as you were once disobedient to God but have now received mercy because of their disobedience,
text_cn: 就如你们以前背叛了天主，如今却因了他们的背叛而蒙受了怜悯；

text_en: so they have now been disobedient in order that, by the mercy shown to you, they too may now receive mercy.
text_cn: 同样，因了你们所受的怜悯；他们如今背叛，这是为叫他们今后也蒙受怜悯，

text_en: For God has imprisoned all in disobedience so that he may be merciful to all.
text_cn: 因为天主把众人都禁锢在背叛之中，是为要怜悯众人。

text_en: O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments and how inscrutable his ways!
text_cn: 啊，天主的富饶、上智和知识，是多么高深！他的决断是多么不可测量！他的道路是多么不可探察！

text_en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor? ”
text_cn: 有谁曾知道上主的心意？或者，有谁曾当过他的顾问？

text_en: “Or who has given a gift to him, to receive a gift in return? ”
text_cn: 或者，有谁曾先施恩于他，而望他还报呢？

text_en: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen.
text_cn: 因为万物都出于他，依赖他，而归于他。愿光荣归于他至于永世！阿们。
